h1: Instagram Story Ad Images Built Around a Square Product Photo
lead: Create a square product image for an Instagram or Facebook Story layout, then place it on a tall canvas with your headline, price, and offer in the surrounding space. For full-screen motion, use a 9:16 video.
intro: This template gives you a square product image with a scene that can sit inside an Instagram or Facebook Story design. Place the image in the middle of a tall canvas, keep the upper and lower areas open for your headline and offer, and finish the layout in Canva or Ads Manager.

A square source keeps the product easy to inspect in feed posts, carousels, and listing galleries while giving you one clean visual to reuse in a Story layout. When the Story needs full-screen movement instead of a still image, use the [Video Ads tool](/ai-video-generation/ugc-ad-video) and choose the 9:16 video frame.
tip: Keep the product clear in the square image, then reserve the top and bottom of the Story canvas for your account name, headline, price, and ad button.

steps.d: Use a straight-on photo of the tube, bottle, or box with the label readable and the whole item inside the square frame.
Choose a calm setting such as a pool deck, shelf, doorway, or wall, and leave room around the product for a Story layout.
Download the square image, place it on your Story canvas, and add your headline, price, or code in Canva or Ads Manager.

ideas.d: Sun care, swimwear, and travel minis by a pool, on a beach towel, or in an open suitcase.
Set a gift box on a table with wrapping paper and string lights in the weeks before the holidays.
The same square image inside a Story layout runs in Facebook Stories, so the same square image can sit inside both Story layouts in Ads Manager.

faq.q: Can the story image include my price or discount code?
faq.a: Put them on after downloading, using Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager. Words generated inside an image can come out misspelled, so it's made without text.

faq.q: Can I mention SPF or skin benefits in the ad?
faq.a: Stick to the wording printed on your product's label, and add it as text yourself. The image shows the product in its setting and shouldn't promise results like protection or clearer skin.

faq.q: Why not crop a square photo to fit Stories?
faq.a: A square image remains easy to inspect when it sits inside a Story layout with space around it. Place it on a tall canvas and add your headline, price, and code around the image. If you need the product to move across the full phone screen, make a separate 9:16 video instead.

faq.q: What dimensions should an Instagram Story image use?
faq.a: Start with the square product image from this template, then place it on a tall Story canvas and add your exact price, discount code, and readable text in the editor. For a full-screen moving Story, make a separate 9:16 video.

overview.p: Place a square product image in the middle of a tall Story canvas. Keep the areas above and below open for your headline, price, code, and call to action, which you add in the design or ad tool.

overview.h2: Use video when the phone screen should move
overview.p: For full-screen movement, make a separate 9:16 video in the [Video Ads tool](/ai-video-generation/ugc-ad-video). The photo template keeps its square product view.
